data_description.scan_interval: Values are always re-read on this interval, whether or not Auto-Subscription below is enabled.
data_description.subscription_enabled: When on, changed values are pushed the instant the PLC reports them, on top of the regular polling interval. Turn off to use polling only.

nodes.title: Select a discovered node
nodes.description: Search by name or NodeId. Save one node at a time; reopen these options to configure another.

node.title: Entity type
node.description: Node: {node}. Only compatible entity types are offered. Automatic keeps the existing mapping. Changing the domain creates a new entity; update automations and dashboards before removing the previous entity. Excluded nodes are not polled after reload.

number.title: Numeric limits
number.description: Node: {node}. Choose the editable range and control step. These are interface limits; they do not change the PLC configuration.

data_description.deadband: Auto-Subscription only: suppress a push update smaller than this absolute change (e.g. 0.01 hides float noise below the 2nd decimal). 0 disables filtering. Polling is unaffected and always reads the exact value.

sensor.title: Sensor options
sensor.description: Node: {node}. A read-only numeric node has no editable range, but its push updates can still be filtered.

data_description.deadband: Auto-Subscription only: suppress a push update smaller than this absolute change (e.g. 0.01 hides float noise below the 2nd decimal). 0 disables filtering. Polling is unaffected and always reads the exact value.

text.title: Text limits
text.description: Node: {node}. Set the maximum to the string capacity configured in the PLC (up to 255 characters for Home Assistant). Capacity is not discovered automatically. Spaces are preserved.

error.incompatible_platform: This entity type is incompatible with the node type or write permissions.
error.node_not_found: The node is no longer available. Reload the integration.
error.invalid_number_limits: Use finite numbers, minimum below maximum, and a positive step no greater than the range.
error.integer_limits_required: This node requires integer limits and step.
error.unsafe_integer_limits: Integer limits must be within ±9007199254740991 for exact representation in the interface.
error.limits_outside_type: The limits exceed the OPC UA data type range.
error.invalid_text_limits: Use integer lengths with 0 ≤ minimum ≤ maximum ≤ 255.
error.invalid_deadband: Use a finite deadband of 0 or more (an integer for integer node types).

abort.no_nodes: No supported scalar nodes were discovered. Check the root NodeId and permissions, then reload.

orphan_entity.title: Remove orphaned entity: {entity_id}
orphan_entity.description: Entity `{entity_id}` on endpoint **{endpoint}** is no longer used by the current configuration, or its node is absent after a complete discovery. You can delete the old entity from the Home Assistant registry together with its saved node settings. Before confirming, update any automations, scripts and dashboards that reference it. The PLC and other entities are not changed.

confirm.title: Remove orphaned entity: {entity_id}
confirm.description: Entity `{entity_id}` on endpoint **{endpoint}** is no longer used by the current configuration, or its node is absent after a complete discovery. You can delete the old entity from the Home Assistant registry. Before confirming, update any automations, scripts and dashboards that reference it. The PLC node, settings and other entities are not changed.

abort.no_longer_orphan: The entity is no longer orphaned, was already removed, or cannot currently be verified. No entity was deleted.
